scope: Choose a calendar or address book, Save As, safer updates, and over 40 fixes found by testing like a customer.

topics.title: Choose a calendar or address book
details: With two email accounts in Thunderbird, you can choose one calendar or address book, or all of them.
Press Control+L in Calendar or Contacts. You can also say show Gmail calendar, or show all contacts.
Say which calendar am I in, or which address book am I in.

topics.title: Save As
details: In a document, press F12 to save a copy with a new name or in a new folder.
Insert+F12 or Caps Lock+F12 still say the time in a document. F12 still says the time on other screens.
You can also say save as, or use the File menu.

topics.title: New key to attach a file
details: Control+O now attaches a file to an email. Control+T still works for now.

topics.title: Updates
details: Updates now close Voice Companion's own programs first, so they no longer fail.
Your own programs are never closed. If one is in the way, you hear which one to close.

topics.title: Documents
details: A new document asks for its name first.
New documents always go in the same folder.

topics.title: Safer answers
details: Saying that one at Exit or Shut down no longer means yes. No is still chosen first.

topics.title: Websites
details: Saying yes now opens a website you asked for from the main menu.
Text you say into a web box is no longer lost after new line.

topics.title: Many smaller fixes
details: Large text no longer hides the main menu on small screens.
Messages are no longer cut off when you leave a note or a website.
Radio times now sound like you would say them.
